rows.candidate: Use compact direct ID-to-slot lookup for dense walk file IDs
rows.estimated_savings: Current file-ID lookup stores u64 keys and usize positions in hash buckets. A guarded Vec<u32> slot table can use about 4 bytes per dense ID, versus approximately 17 bytes per hash bucket including control bytes. At about 1.7 million files, geometric capacities suggest roughly 26 MiB less lookup storage; this is a non-additive engineering estimate, not measured whole-process savings. Sparse/u64::MAX IDs must fall back to the current map.
